# AI SaaS Foundation

Purpose: reusable production foundation for AI SaaS products.

Start with README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/architecture.md and skills/README.md.

Code ownership:
- apps/web: Next.js application
- packages/ai: all model/provider selection
- packages/agents: opt-in agent loops
- packages/tools: external tools/APIs
- packages/db: Supabase clients
- supabase/migrations: schema and RLS

Non-negotiables: no secrets, no direct provider calls from features, validate input, RLS for user data, deterministic tests plus AI evals.
